# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	### 2.1 bf16 与 fp16 的位布局差异
17	
18	| 格式 | 符号位 | 指数位 | 尾数位 | 动态范围 | 有效精度 |
19	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
20	| fp32 | 1 | 8 | 23 | 约 \(2^{-126}\) ~ \(2^{127}\) | ~7 位十进制 |
21	| bf16 | 1 | **8** | **7** | 与 fp32 相同 | ~2~3 位十进制 |
22	| fp16 | 1 | **5** | 10 | \(2^{-14}\)（正规数）~ 65504 | ~3~4 位十进制 |
23	
24	关键区别：
25	
26	- **fp16 的指数位只有 5 个**，正规数最小约 \(6 \times 10^{-5}\)，比它小的梯度只能挤进精度极差的 subnormal 区，再小就下溢为 0。大模型梯度普遍很小，直接用 fp16 存梯度会大量"归零"，所以必须先把 loss 放大（loss scaling，见 u4-l1）再 backward，让梯度整体搬进可表示区间。
27	- **bf16 的指数位与 fp32 一样是 8 个**，动态范围完整覆盖 fp32 的区间，梯度几乎不会因为"太小"而下溢。它的代价是尾数只有 7 位，精度粗（相邻可表示数的间距大），但这个误差性质上是"舍入噪声"而不是"整段丢失"，对随机梯度下降是良性的。所以 **bf16 训练不需要 loss scaling**。
28	
29	### 2.2 master weights 与混合精度训练
30	
31	混合精度训练的前向/反向用低精度（bf16/fp16）算，但权重更新必须回到 fp32：学习率乘以梯度往往远小于 bf16 的舍入间距 \(w\) 本身，若直接在 bf16 权重上加更新量 \(w + \Delta w\) 可能被舍回 \(w\)，小更新完全丢失。因此优化器内部维护一份 **fp32 主权重（masters）**，低精度权重只是它同步出来的投影。u4-l2 讲过 fp16 包装优化器如何做这件事，本讲讲 bf16 的对应实现 `BF16_Optimizer`。
32	
33	### 2.3 梯度累积 dtype
34	
35	配置项 `data_types.grad_accum_dtype` 决定 backward 产生并累积的梯度用什么精度（默认跟随模型 dtype）。**bf16 模型 + fp32 梯度累积**是数值上最稳的组合，也是本讲的中心线索——它会触发专门化的 `BF16_Optimizer`（见 4.1）。

49	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

51	### 4.1 BF16_Optimizer 主循环
52	
53	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
54	
55	`BF16_Optimizer` 是 bf16 训练的包装优化器（继承 `ZeROOptimizer` 接口），它解决的问题是：**前向/反向用 bf16 保吞吐，权重更新用 fp32 保精度，同时把 fp32 主权重按数据并行维度切分以省显存**——可以理解为"轻量版 ZeRO-1"：只切分主权重和优化器状态，梯度保持全量。
56	
57	引擎在两个场景会选择它（见 [engine.py:L2313-L2342](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2313-L2342) 的 `_do_optimizer_sanity_check`）：
58	
59	1. **专门化 ZeRO-1 路径**：开启了 ZeRO、stage 恰为 1、模型 dtype 是 bf16、梯度累积 dtype 是 fp32、且没有 CPU 卸载时，返回 `BFLOAT16` 分发标志——这就是 PR 描述里"dedicated ZeRO-1 BF16 optimizer"的由来。`tests/unit/checkpoint/test_fp32_master_stage3_bf16.py` 正是用 `zero_optimization.stage=1` + `data_types.grad_accum_dtype="fp32"` + `bf16.enabled=true` 组合出这条路径的。
60	2. **关闭 ZeRO 的流水线 bf16 路径**：没开 ZeRO、模型 dtype 与梯度累积 dtype 相同且都是 bf16、且开启了流水线并行时，同样返回 `BFLOAT16`（同时打warning 提示大累积步数下 bf16 累积的数值风险）。
61	
62	注意别混淆：**普通 DDP bf16（关 ZeRO、不开流水线）走的是 `DDP_BFLOAT16` 分发标志**，在 [engine.py:L2379-L2381](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2379-L2381) 被交给 `_configure_fp16_optimizer`（即 u4-l2 讲的 FP16 家族包装器，只是低精度 dtype 换成 bf16），不会经过本讲的 `BF16_Optimizer`。
63	
64	因为 bf16 不需要 loss scaling，这个类里与 loss scaler 相关的属性全部是为了 API 兼容而设的占位符。

66	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
67	
68	一次完整的梯度更新周期：
69	
70	```text
71	backward（引擎侧，每微批次）
72	  backward_prologue:  清零 lp(bf16) 梯度
73	  autograd 产生 bf16 param.grad
74	  backward_epilogue → update_hp_grads:
75	      把 lp.grad 累加进全量 fp32 扁平梯度缓冲（hp_grad）
76	step（梯度累积边界，每 gas 个微批次一次）
77	  1. 计算（专家/非专家分组的）全局梯度范数
78	  2. 范数无效（inf/nan）→ 判定溢出，清空 hp/lp 梯度，直接返回
79	  3. clip_grad > 0 → 按全局范数裁剪
80	  4. 把本 rank 的 fp32 梯度分区拷给 fp32 主权重分区的 .grad
81	  5. 调用包装的底层优化器 optimizer.step()（在 fp32 分区上更新 masters）
82	  6. update_lp_params: 把更新后的 fp32 分区拷回 bf16 分区，
83	     再 all-gather 拼出全量 bf16 扁平权重
84	  7. 清空 fp32 梯度缓冲
85	```
86

88	
89	| 张量 | 精度 | 覆盖范围 | 每参数字节 |
90	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
91	| `bf16_groups_flat` | bf16 | 全量 | 2 |
92	| `fp32_groups_flat_partition` | fp32 | 本 rank 分区 | \(4/N\) |
93	| `fp32_groups_gradients_flat` | fp32 | 全量 | 4 |
94	| 底层优化器状态（如 Adam 两个矩） | fp32 | 本 rank 分区 | \(8/N\) |

156	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
157	
158	**练习 1**：为什么 `BF16_Optimizer.__init__` 里直接 `assert grad_acc_dtype in [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16]`，而不允许别的累积精度？
159	
160	**答案**：梯度累积缓冲的 dtype 决定了 backward 期间梯度的驻留精度。允许的集合就是"至少与模型同精度"：fp32 是数值最优选择（专门化路径的触发条件），bf16 是省内存的默认行为；fp16 累积既没有 bf16 的动态范围优势，又比 fp32 精度差，属于被有意排除的组合。
161	
162	**练习 2**：`update_lp_params` 里为什么必须先 `copy_` 再 all-gather，而不能直接 all-gather fp32 分区？
163	
164	**答案**：模型参数是 bf16，前向读的是 bf16 扁平存储；all-gather 的目标张量就是这块 bf16 存储，所以必须先把 fp32 masters 的更新结果降精度写回本 rank 的 bf16 分区，再在 bf16 精度上聚合全量权重。若直接聚合 fp32，每卡要多付出 4 字节/参数的通信量，且模型侧还得再做一次降精度拷贝。
165	
166	**练习 3**：`step` 中 [L402-L407](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/bf16_optimizer.py#L402-L407) 的溢出处理与 u4-l1 里 `DynamicLossScaler.update_scale` 的溢出处理有何本质区别？
167	
168	**答案**：fp16 路径检测到溢出后**调小 scale 重试**（损失可恢复，训练继续）；BF16 路径没有 scale，梯度 inf/nan 意味着这一步本身坏了，只能**丢弃该步**（清空梯度直接返回），不存在"缩小放大倍数再来一次"的补救手段。

239	### 4.3 keep_in_fp32 精度策略
240	
241	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
242	
243	`keep_in_fp32.py` 解决的是混合精度的一个"少数派报告"问题：**个别张量在低精度下会直接破坏模型行为，必须豁免于 dtype 转换**。最典型的是 MoE 模型的路由偏置 `e_score_correction_bias`（DeepSeek-V3、GLM-4.5/5 等都有）：它在 GLM-5.2 中取值约 5~20，相邻值差小于 0.01，而 bf16 在该量级的相邻可表示数间距是 0.03~0.125——转成 bf16 后 256 个专家只剩 3~16 个不同取值，**token 会被路由到错误的专家**。这类误差不像梯度噪声那样可平均掉，而是系统性的决策错误。
244	
245	两个要点：
246	
247	- 豁免对象是 HuggingFace 模型类属性 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`（bf16/fp16 下都保留）与 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（仅 fp16 下保留）点名的**缓冲区（buffer）**；参数即使名字匹配也仍跟随训练 dtype（模块 docstring L25 明确此边界）。
248	- 配置项 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules` 决定名单来源：`"auto"`（默认，取模型自带的两个列表）、自定义通配模式列表、`[]`（全部不保留）。

250	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
251	
252	```text
253	引擎构造期（bf16/fp16 启用时）
254	  keep_in_fp32_pattern(model, setting, dtype)
255	      → 遍历 named_modules，收集各子模块两个类属性里的名字
256	      → "*" 转正则 ".*"，加上模块名前缀，合成一个交替匹配的编译正则
257	  → 引擎 _cast_module_mixed_precision 转换模型 dtype 时跳过匹配的 buffer
258	  → keep_buffers_in_fp32 把已转换的匹配 buffer 就地 .float() 恢复
259	ZeRO-3 场景
260	  → zero.Init 构建期同样调用这两个函数（partition_parameters.py）
261	```
262

264	
265	**① 名单与动机。** 模块 docstring [keep_in_fp32.py:L5-L26](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L5-L26) 完整交代了背景：transformers 自己加载模型时会尊重这两个列表，但在 ZeRO-3 下 `zero.Init` 把 `__init__` 里创建的每个浮点张量都转成训练 dtype，transformers 的加载器再把检查点拷进这些张量，名单就丢了——所以 DeepSpeed 必须在引擎侧重新实现这份豁免。

313	### 4.4 load_state_dict 的 masters 重建（本周期更新）
314	
315	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
316	
317	检查点恢复时，fp32 masters 从哪里来是一个有损/无损的分叉：
318	
319	- **无损**：从检查点里保存的 `SINGLE_PARTITION_OF_FP32_GROUPS`（fp32 分区副本）直接拷贝。
320	- **有损重建**：丢弃保存的 masters，从已加载的 bf16 权重升精度重建（`_restore_from_bit16_weights`）——bf16 只有 7 位尾数，重建必然丢掉 masters 中低于 bf16 分辨率的位。
321	
322	本周期 PR #8892 补全了这个语义矩阵，核心变化是 `BF16_Optimizer._load_legacy_checkpoint` 新增 `load_from_fp32_weights=False` 分支：**此前该参数被静默忽略（无论如何都拷贝保存的 fp32 分区），现在 False 时改为从 bit16 权重重建**，与 ZeRO stage 1/2 的既有行为（[stage_1_and_2.py:L3740-L3749](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage_1_and_2.py#L3740-L3749) 的 docstring 写明两种选项）对齐。 ZeRO-3 的 `_rigid_load_state_dict` / `_load_universal_checkpoint` 同一 PR 也加了同样的分支（本讲聚焦 BF16 优化器，ZeRO-3 侧详见 u5-l8）。
323	
324	完整的恢复矩阵（引擎 `load_checkpoint` 视角）：
325	
326	| 加载方式 | masters 来源 | Adam moments |
327	| --- | --- | --- |
328	| 正常恢复（默认） | 检查点保存的 fp32 masters（引擎硬编码传 `load_from_fp32_weights=True`） | 检查点恢复 |
329	| `load_optimizer_states=False` | **保留**保存的 fp32 masters | 重新开始（fresh） |
330	| `load_module_only=True`（bf16 专用优化器） | 从加载的 bf16 权重**重建** | 重新开始 |
331	| 直接调 `optimizer.load_state_dict(..., load_from_fp32_weights=False)` | 从 bit16 权重**重建** | 由 `load_optimizer_states` 决定 |
332	
333	另有两个配套语义：`load_optimizer_states=False` 时不恢复 `clip_grad` 等优化器全局量（保持当前引擎设置）；配置项 `zero_optimization.load_from_fp32_weights` 保持"已废弃、被忽略"状态。
334	
335	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
336	
337	```text
338	engine.load_checkpoint(tag, load_optimizer_states=?, load_module_only=?)
339	  │  硬编码 load_from_fp32_weights=True（engine.py L4812-L4817）
340	  ▼
341	optimizer.load_state_dict(state_dict_list, load_optimizer_states,
342	                          load_from_fp32_weights, ...)
343	  ├─ checkpoint_folder 非空 → _load_universal_checkpoint（universal 格式）
344	  └─ 否则 → _load_legacy_checkpoint
345	        ├─ load_optimizer_states=True:
346	        │     恢复 clip_grad；optimizer.load_state_dict(moments)
347	        ├─ load_from_fp32_weights=True:
348	        │     逐组把保存的 fp32 分区（经 _get_padded_tensor 补齐）copy_ 进当前分区
349	        ├─ else（本周期新增）:
350	        │     _restore_from_bit16_weights()   # 从 bf16 分区升精度重建 masters
351	        └─ load_optimizer_states=True: 重新链接 lp↔hp 映射
352	```

# u4-l3 BF16 优化器与低精度主权重

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 从浮点格式的指数位/尾数位出发，解释 **bf16 为什么不需要 loss scaling**，而 fp16 必须（承接 u4-l1）。
2. 画出 `BF16_Optimizer` 的内存布局：bf16 扁平权重（全量）+ fp32 主权重分区（本 rank 份额）+ fp32 扁平梯度（全量），并按 DP 世界大小估算每参数字节数。
3. 说出引擎在什么条件下会选择 `BF16_Optimizer`（专门化 ZeRO-1 路径与 DDP 式路径），以及 `data_types.grad_accum_dtype` 在其中的作用。
4. 掌握 2025/12 引入的低精度 master states 配置：`bf16.bf16_master_weights_and_grads` 与 `bf16.bf16_optimizer_states` 的语义、依赖关系和卸载约束。
5. 理解 `keep_in_fp32` 精度策略：为什么 MoE 路由偏置这类**缓冲区**在 bf16 训练中必须留在 fp32。
6. 解读本周期（PR #8892）`load_state_dict` 的 masters 恢复语义：`load_from_fp32_weights=False` 时从 bit16 权重重建 fp32 主权重；引擎 `load_checkpoint` 正常恢复仍传 `True`；`load_optimizer_states=False` 保留 masters 并让 Adam moments 重新开始。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 bf16 与 fp16 的位布局差异

| 格式 | 符号位 | 指数位 | 尾数位 | 动态范围 | 有效精度 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fp32 | 1 | 8 | 23 | 约 \(2^{-126}\) ~ \(2^{127}\) | ~7 位十进制 |
| bf16 | 1 | **8** | **7** | 与 fp32 相同 | ~2~3 位十进制 |
| fp16 | 1 | **5** | 10 | \(2^{-14}\)（正规数）~ 65504 | ~3~4 位十进制 |

关键区别：

- **fp16 的指数位只有 5 个**，正规数最小约 \(6 \times 10^{-5}\)，比它小的梯度只能挤进精度极差的 subnormal 区，再小就下溢为 0。大模型梯度普遍很小，直接用 fp16 存梯度会大量"归零"，所以必须先把 loss 放大（loss scaling，见 u4-l1）再 backward，让梯度整体搬进可表示区间。
- **bf16 的指数位与 fp32 一样是 8 个**，动态范围完整覆盖 fp32 的区间，梯度几乎不会因为"太小"而下溢。它的代价是尾数只有 7 位，精度粗（相邻可表示数的间距大），但这个误差性质上是"舍入噪声"而不是"整段丢失"，对随机梯度下降是良性的。所以 **bf16 训练不需要 loss scaling**。

### 2.2 master weights 与混合精度训练

混合精度训练的前向/反向用低精度（bf16/fp16）算，但权重更新必须回到 fp32：学习率乘以梯度往往远小于 bf16 的舍入间距 \(w\) 本身，若直接在 bf16 权重上加更新量 \(w + \Delta w\) 可能被舍回 \(w\)，小更新完全丢失。因此优化器内部维护一份 **fp32 主权重（masters）**，低精度权重只是它同步出来的投影。u4-l2 讲过 fp16 包装优化器如何做这件事，本讲讲 bf16 的对应实现 `BF16_Optimizer`。

### 2.3 梯度累积 dtype

配置项 `data_types.grad_accum_dtype` 决定 backward 产生并累积的梯度用什么精度（默认跟随模型 dtype）。**bf16 模型 + fp32 梯度累积**是数值上最稳的组合，也是本讲的中心线索——它会触发专门化的 `BF16_Optimizer`（见 4.1）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 BF16_Optimizer 主循环

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`BF16_Optimizer` 是 bf16 训练的包装优化器（继承 `ZeROOptimizer` 接口），它解决的问题是：**前向/反向用 bf16 保吞吐，权重更新用 fp32 保精度，同时把 fp32 主权重按数据并行维度切分以省显存**——可以理解为"轻量版 ZeRO-1"：只切分主权重和优化器状态，梯度保持全量。

引擎在两个场景会选择它（见 [engine.py:L2313-L2342](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2313-L2342) 的 `_do_optimizer_sanity_check`）：

1. **专门化 ZeRO-1 路径**：开启了 ZeRO、stage 恰为 1、模型 dtype 是 bf16、梯度累积 dtype 是 fp32、且没有 CPU 卸载时，返回 `BFLOAT16` 分发标志——这就是 PR 描述里"dedicated ZeRO-1 BF16 optimizer"的由来。`tests/unit/checkpoint/test_fp32_master_stage3_bf16.py` 正是用 `zero_optimization.stage=1` + `data_types.grad_accum_dtype="fp32"` + `bf16.enabled=true` 组合出这条路径的。
2. **关闭 ZeRO 的流水线 bf16 路径**：没开 ZeRO、模型 dtype 与梯度累积 dtype 相同且都是 bf16、且开启了流水线并行时，同样返回 `BFLOAT16`（同时打warning 提示大累积步数下 bf16 累积的数值风险）。

注意别混淆：**普通 DDP bf16（关 ZeRO、不开流水线）走的是 `DDP_BFLOAT16` 分发标志**，在 [engine.py:L2379-L2381](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2379-L2381) 被交给 `_configure_fp16_optimizer`（即 u4-l2 讲的 FP16 家族包装器，只是低精度 dtype 换成 bf16），不会经过本讲的 `BF16_Optimizer`。

因为 bf16 不需要 loss scaling，这个类里与 loss scaler 相关的属性全部是为了 API 兼容而设的占位符。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次完整的梯度更新周期：

```text
backward（引擎侧，每微批次）
  backward_prologue:  清零 lp(bf16) 梯度
  autograd 产生 bf16 param.grad
  backward_epilogue → update_hp_grads:
      把 lp.grad 累加进全量 fp32 扁平梯度缓冲（hp_grad）
step（梯度累积边界，每 gas 个微批次一次）
  1. 计算（专家/非专家分组的）全局梯度范数
  2. 范数无效（inf/nan）→ 判定溢出，清空 hp/lp 梯度，直接返回
  3. clip_grad > 0 → 按全局范数裁剪
  4. 把本 rank 的 fp32 梯度分区拷给 fp32 主权重分区的 .grad
  5. 调用包装的底层优化器 optimizer.step()（在 fp32 分区上更新 masters）
  6. update_lp_params: 把更新后的 fp32 分区拷回 bf16 分区，
     再 all-gather 拼出全量 bf16 扁平权重
  7. 清空 fp32 梯度缓冲
```

内存布局（设数据并行世界大小为 \(N\)，可训练参数量 \(\Psi\)，`grad_accum_dtype=fp32`）：

| 张量 | 精度 | 覆盖范围 | 每参数字节 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bf16_groups_flat` | bf16 | 全量 | 2 |
| `fp32_groups_flat_partition` | fp32 | 本 rank 分区 | \(4/N\) |
| `fp32_groups_gradients_flat` | fp32 | 全量 | 4 |
| 底层优化器状态（如 Adam 两个矩） | fp32 | 本 rank 分区 | \(8/N\) |

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `BF16_Optimizer.__init__` 里直接 `assert grad_acc_dtype in [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16]`，而不允许别的累积精度？

**答案**：梯度累积缓冲的 dtype 决定了 backward 期间梯度的驻留精度。允许的集合就是"至少与模型同精度"：fp32 是数值最优选择（专门化路径的触发条件），bf16 是省内存的默认行为；fp16 累积既没有 bf16 的动态范围优势，又比 fp32 精度差，属于被有意排除的组合。

**练习 2**：`update_lp_params` 里为什么必须先 `copy_` 再 all-gather，而不能直接 all-gather fp32 分区？

**答案**：模型参数是 bf16，前向读的是 bf16 扁平存储；all-gather 的目标张量就是这块 bf16 存储，所以必须先把 fp32 masters 的更新结果降精度写回本 rank 的 bf16 分区，再在 bf16 精度上聚合全量权重。若直接聚合 fp32，每卡要多付出 4 字节/参数的通信量，且模型侧还得再做一次降精度拷贝。

**练习 3**：`step` 中 [L402-L407](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/bf16_optimizer.py#L402-L407) 的溢出处理与 u4-l1 里 `DynamicLossScaler.update_scale` 的溢出处理有何本质区别？

**答案**：fp16 路径检测到溢出后**调小 scale 重试**（损失可恢复，训练继续）；BF16 路径没有 scale，梯度 inf/nan 意味着这一步本身坏了，只能**丢弃该步**（清空梯度直接返回），不存在"缩小放大倍数再来一次"的补救手段。

### 4.2 precision_config 解析与低精度 master states

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`precision_config.py` 用 pydantic 模型把 JSON 里的 `"bf16": {...}` 块解析成 `DeepSpeedBF16Config`。除基础的 `enabled`/`immediate_grad_update`/`check_grad_overflow` 外，2025/12 引入了两个**低精度 master states** 开关，允许把 ZeRO 的 master 权重（乃至优化器状态）也压到 bf16，进一步换显存：

- `bf16_master_weights_and_grads`：master 参数/梯度用 bf16 而非 fp32（省 \(2+2\) 字节/参数的分区开销）。
- `bf16_optimizer_states`：Adam 矩也用 bf16（再省 \(4\) 字节/参数分区）。文档给出的账本：卸载场景下 bf16 master + 两个 bf16 矩约 6 字节/参数，矩保持 fp32 约 10 字节/参数。

注意区分：这两个开关作用于 **ZeRO 优化器**（stage 1/2/3 的 `DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer` / `_Stage3`），而不是 4.1 的 `BF16_Optimizer`——后者本身就是"bf16 权重 + fp32 masters"的专用实现。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
JSON "bf16" 块
  → get_bfloat16_config() 兼容旧键名 "bfloat16"
  → DeepSpeedBF16Config（pydantic 校验，未知字段报错）
  → DeepSpeedConfig._do_sanity_check 校验跨字段约束：
        低精度 master 开关要求 ZeRO 开启且 stage ∈ {1,2,3}
        bf16_optimizer_states 要求 bf16_master_weights_and_grads=true
  → 引擎把开关传给 ZeRO 优化器构造
  → base_optimizer._configure_master_weights 统一校验并返回 master dtype
```

**答案**：控制 **ZeRO stage 1/2 优化器**在 bf16 模式下是否做梯度溢出检测（[engine.py:L2657-L2662](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2657-L2662) 读取后传给 `_configure_zero_optimizer`，在 stage_1_and_2.py L3078 附近消费）。专门化 `BF16_Optimizer` 的 `step` 则总是检查 `is_invalid_grad_norm`，不读这个字段。字段默认值 True 是为了与 fp16 的默认行为对齐（docstring 引用 issue #5242 / PR #6976）。

**练习 2**：为什么"bf16 master + fp32 矩"必须搭配 CPU 卸载？

**答案**：这个组合省的是 master 的 2 字节/参数（分区），但矩仍是 8 字节/参数（fp32）。如果不卸载，fp32 矩留在 GPU 上，显存大头没省；卸载到 CPU 后矩占用的是主机内存，GPU 上只剩 bf16 master 与梯度，显存收益才兑现——所以校验强制 `DeepSpeedCPUAdam`。反过来"全 bf16"时状态足够小，可以留在 GPU 也可以卸载（见文档矩阵）。

### 4.3 keep_in_fp32 精度策略

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`keep_in_fp32.py` 解决的是混合精度的一个"少数派报告"问题：**个别张量在低精度下会直接破坏模型行为，必须豁免于 dtype 转换**。最典型的是 MoE 模型的路由偏置 `e_score_correction_bias`（DeepSeek-V3、GLM-4.5/5 等都有）：它在 GLM-5.2 中取值约 5~20，相邻值差小于 0.01，而 bf16 在该量级的相邻可表示数间距是 0.03~0.125——转成 bf16 后 256 个专家只剩 3~16 个不同取值，**token 会被路由到错误的专家**。这类误差不像梯度噪声那样可平均掉，而是系统性的决策错误。

两个要点：

- 豁免对象是 HuggingFace 模型类属性 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`（bf16/fp16 下都保留）与 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（仅 fp16 下保留）点名的**缓冲区（buffer）**；参数即使名字匹配也仍跟随训练 dtype（模块 docstring L25 明确此边界）。
- 配置项 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules` 决定名单来源：`"auto"`（默认，取模型自带的两个列表）、自定义通配模式列表、`[]`（全部不保留）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
引擎构造期（bf16/fp16 启用时）
  keep_in_fp32_pattern(model, setting, dtype)
      → 遍历 named_modules，收集各子模块两个类属性里的名字
      → "*" 转正则 ".*"，加上模块名前缀，合成一个交替匹配的编译正则
  → 引擎 _cast_module_mixed_precision 转换模型 dtype 时跳过匹配的 buffer
  → keep_buffers_in_fp32 把已转换的匹配 buffer 就地 .float() 恢复
ZeRO-3 场景
  → zero.Init 构建期同样调用这两个函数（partition_parameters.py）
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① 名单与动机。** 模块 docstring [keep_in_fp32.py:L5-L26](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L5-L26) 完整交代了背景：transformers 自己加载模型时会尊重这两个列表，但在 ZeRO-3 下 `zero.Init` 把 `__init__` 里创建的每个浮点张量都转成训练 dtype，transformers 的加载器再把检查点拷进这些张量，名单就丢了——所以 DeepSpeed 必须在引擎侧重新实现这份豁免。

**② 模式编译。** [keep_in_fp32_pattern（L35-L58）](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L35-L58)：dtype 是 fp32 时直接返回 `None`（纯 fp32 训练无需豁免，L40-L41）；`auto` 模式下遍历模块收集名单，fp16 时额外并入 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（L46-L47）；最后 `"|".join` 成单个正则（L58），匹配规则与 transformers 的 `build_glob_glob_alternation` + `re.search` 一致——模式可以匹配完整 buffer 名的任意位置。

**③ buffer 的筛选与就地转换。** [buffers_to_keep_in_fp32（L61-L69）](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L61-L69) 只挑**浮点 buffer**（`recurse=False` 防止重复计数）；[keep_buffers_in_fp32（L72-L79）](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L72-L79) 把 dtype 不是 fp32 的匹配 buffer 用 `buf.data = buf.data.float()` 就地恢复并计数。

**④ 两个消费点。** 非 ZeRO-3 路径在 [engine.py:L2099-L2107](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2099-L2107)：dtype 转换只针对参数、默认保留 fp32 buffer（注释点名 rotary 的 `inv_freq`），`keep_pattern` 交给 `_cast_module_mixed_precision`；ZeRO-3 路径在 [partition_parameters.py:L1262-L1265](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1262-L1265) 于 `zero.Init` 期间调用同一对函数。

### 4.4 load_state_dict 的 masters 重建（本周期更新）

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

检查点恢复时，fp32 masters 从哪里来是一个有损/无损的分叉：

- **无损**：从检查点里保存的 `SINGLE_PARTITION_OF_FP32_GROUPS`（fp32 分区副本）直接拷贝。
- **有损重建**：丢弃保存的 masters，从已加载的 bf16 权重升精度重建（`_restore_from_bit16_weights`）——bf16 只有 7 位尾数，重建必然丢掉 masters 中低于 bf16 分辨率的位。

本周期 PR #8892 补全了这个语义矩阵，核心变化是 `BF16_Optimizer._load_legacy_checkpoint` 新增 `load_from_fp32_weights=False` 分支：**此前该参数被静默忽略（无论如何都拷贝保存的 fp32 分区），现在 False 时改为从 bit16 权重重建**，与 ZeRO stage 1/2 的既有行为（[stage_1_and_2.py:L3740-L3749](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/02f7978481cb3d3297f111c02b16d768b890b256/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage_1_and_2.py#L3740-L3749) 的 docstring 写明两种选项）对齐。 ZeRO-3 的 `_rigid_load_state_dict` / `_load_universal_checkpoint` 同一 PR 也加了同样的分支（本讲聚焦 BF16 优化器，ZeRO-3 侧详见 u5-l8）。

完整的恢复矩阵（引擎 `load_checkpoint` 视角）：

| 加载方式 | masters 来源 | Adam moments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 正常恢复（默认） | 检查点保存的 fp32 masters（引擎硬编码传 `load_from_fp32_weights=True`） | 检查点恢复 |
| `load_optimizer_states=False` | **保留**保存的 fp32 masters | 重新开始（fresh） |
| `load_module_only=True`（bf16 专用优化器） | 从加载的 bf16 权重**重建** | 重新开始 |
| 直接调 `optimizer.load_state_dict(..., load_from_fp32_weights=False)` | 从 bit16 权重**重建** | 由 `load_optimizer_states` 决定 |

另有两个配套语义：`load_optimizer_states=False` 时不恢复 `clip_grad` 等优化器全局量（保持当前引擎设置）；配置项 `zero_optimization.load_from_fp32_weights` 保持"已废弃、被忽略"状态。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
engine.load_checkpoint(tag, load_optimizer_states=?, load_module_only=?)
  │  硬编码 load_from_fp32_weights=True（engine.py L4812-L4817）
  ▼
optimizer.load_state_dict(state_dict_list, load_optimizer_states,
                          load_from_fp32_weights, ...)
  ├─ checkpoint_folder 非空 → _load_universal_checkpoint（universal 格式）
  └─ 否则 → _load_legacy_checkpoint
        ├─ load_optimizer_states=True:
        │     恢复 clip_grad；optimizer.load_state_dict(moments)
        ├─ load_from_fp32_weights=True:
        │     逐组把保存的 fp32 分区（经 _get_padded_tensor 补齐）copy_ 进当前分区
        ├─ else（本周期新增）:
        │     _restore_from_bit16_weights()   # 从 bf16 分区升精度重建 masters
        └─ load_optimizer_states=True: 重新链接 lp↔hp 映射
```

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
